settings.heading: Is laser hair removal really permanent?
settings.content: Laser hair removal provides permanent hair reduction, meaning most treated hair will not grow back. After completing your treatment plan (typically 6-8 sessions), you may experience up to 90-95% permanent hair reduction. Some clients may need occasional maintenance sessions for any new hair growth triggered by hormonal changes.

settings.heading: Does laser hair removal hurt?
settings.content: At Deluxe Laser & Aesthetics, we use advanced painless laser technology that makes treatments 100% comfortable. Most clients describe the sensation as a gentle warming feeling on the skin, far less uncomfortable than waxing or threading. Our cooling systems ensure your comfort throughout the entire treatment.

settings.heading: How many sessions will I need?
settings.content: Most clients require 6-8 sessions spaced 4-6 weeks apart to achieve optimal results. The exact number depends on the treatment area, your hair type, skin tone, and individual hair growth cycles. During your complimentary consultation, we'll provide a personalized treatment plan with an estimated number of sessions.

settings.heading: Is laser hair removal safe for all skin types?
settings.content: Yes! Our FDA-approved laser systems are safe and effective for all skin types (I-VI), including darker skin tones. Our expert technicians customise treatment settings based on your individual skin type and hair color to ensure safe, effective results.

settings.heading: What areas can be treated with laser hair removal?
settings.content: We can treat virtually any area of the body where unwanted hair grows. Popular treatment areas for women include legs, underarms, bikini line, face, and upper lip. Men commonly treat back, shoulders, chest, abdomen, and face (beard shaping). We also offer full body laser hair removal packages for both men and women.

settings.heading: Can I shave between laser hair removal sessions?
settings.content: Yes, you can and should shave between sessions. In fact, we recommend shaving the treatment area 24 hours before each appointment. However, avoid waxing, plucking, or threading, as these methods remove the hair follicle that the laser targets.

settings.heading: What should I avoid before and after treatment?
settings.content: Before treatment, avoid sun exposure, tanning beds, and self-tanners for at least 2 weeks. Don't wax, pluck, or use hair removal creams for 4 weeks prior. After treatment, avoid direct sun exposure for 48 hours, apply SPF 30+ sunscreen, and avoid hot baths, saunas, and intense exercise for 24-48 hours.

settings.heading: Are there any side effects?
settings.content: Laser hair removal is very safe when performed by trained professionals. Some clients may experience temporary mild redness or slight swelling immediately after treatment, which typically subsides within a few hours. Serious side effects are extremely rare with our advanced technology and expert technicians.

settings.heading: How long does each session take?
settings.content: Treatment time varies by area size. Small areas like the upper lip take 5-10 minutes, while larger areas like full legs or back can take 45-60 minutes. Our efficient technology allows for quick treatments that fit easily into your schedule.

settings.heading: Where are Deluxe clinics located?
settings.content: We have multiple locations across South Africa including Cape Town (Claremont, Sea Point, Constantia, Gardens), Johannesburg (Fourways), Durban (La Lucia), and other major cities. Visit our locations page or contact us to find the clinic nearest you.
